response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals, architectural thinking, and mentoring capabilities across a 20-year career, there is a critical skills mismatch. The role requires extensive C++ expertise as its core competency, but his recent work (2015–present) focuses primarily on TypeScript, Node.js, and Dlang. His only recent C++ experience was 6 months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, now over a decade old. Additionally, there is no evidence of expertise in industrial cybersecurity standards (SDL, IEC 62443), secure embedded systems development, or industrial automation—all key requirements for this position. His background is predominantly web/SaaS-focused rather than on-premises industrial solutions.
strengths: Extensive engineering experience (20 years) with demonstrated progression to staff-level roles and proven mentoring capabilities
Strong focus on software craftsmanship, testing discipline (TDD), and quality practices; experience architecting scalable, event-driven systems
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and master diverse technical domains, showing architectural depth and adaptability
concerns: Critical gap in current C++ expertise; recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js/Dlang with only 6-month C++ experience from 2014–2015, making him significantly underqualified for a C++-focused role
No demonstrated knowledge of industrial cybersecurity standards (SDL, IEC 62443), secure embedded systems, or security-focused development practices required for this position
Background is entirely web/SaaS/GIS-focused; lacks experience with industrial automation, on-premises embedded systems, IoT protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, OPC UA), or manufacturing platforms
